text: The Sir George Stokes Award, commonly referred to as the Stokes Medal, is named in honor of George Gabriel Stokes and is presented every two years by the Analytical Division of the Royal Society of Chemistry. Established in 1999, the award was created to acknowledge the multidisciplinary aspects of analytical chemistry[1] and is bestowed upon individuals from complementary fields who have made outstanding and sustained contributions to analytical science, resulting in developments of seminal significance to chemical analysis. There are no restrictions on the nationality of candidates eligible for the award. Source: Royal Society of Chemistry
